title: Law to shift pedicab oversight to the Taxi and Limousine Commission
summary: This bill would move licensing, regulation and enforcement of pedicabs from the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to the Taxi and Limousine Commission (TLC), repealing DCWP's current pedicab oversight law. TLC would issue business and driver licenses, set rules and enforce violations, and would also have to study ways to lower insurance costs for pedicab businesses and drivers. The change would take effect 180 days after becoming law.
